question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    p.player_name
FROM (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs,
        pm.team_id,
        m.match_winner
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id
    JOIN player_match pm ON b.match_id = pm.match_id AND b.striker = pm.player_id
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE b.striker IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.striker, pm.team_id, m.match_winner
    HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100
) AS scored
JOIN player p ON scored.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE scored.team_id != scored.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
